key_insight: ASPIS-Net combines acoustic and electrical signals with physics-informed learning to classify CMT weld penetration states and derive interpretable equations.
engineering_relevance: Noise-resilient, interpretable weld-state monitoring could support quality assurance for structurally critical welded joints.
method: Dual-branch network extracts acoustic and electrical features.
Adaptive gated fusion suppresses noise while preserving informative signals.
Symbolic regression translates learned representations into explicit physical equations.
evidence_signal: Evaluation used 5,000 synchronized samples across four penetration states, reporting 99.36% classification accuracy and 75.59% Macro-F1 under 0 dB composite noise.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the tested platform and the physical validity of the derived equations require further validation.
paper_title: Physics-informed multi-sensor fusion framework for predicting weld penetration state and mechanistic discovery in CMT welding
